name: Killstreak Battle Royale
desc:
Welcome to Killstreak! 

Drop into a battle royale where every fight can change the match! Loot powerful weapons, build unstoppable killstreaks, survive the shrinking zone, and become the last team standing! 🔥

💥 BUILD YOUR KILLSTREAK AND UNLEASH POWERFUL ABILITIES! 💥

Earn consecutive eliminations to unlock turrets, drones, healing, speed boosts, nukes, and more!

[How To Play]
• Drop into the battlefield 🪂
• Loot weapons and gear from chests 🔫
• Eliminate enemies and build your killstreak 💥
• Revive your team and survive the final zone! 🏆

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation 5!
